notes: "The workflow does not require one model. The plugin carries authoring guidance and project context. The connector sends requests to the selected project’s shared document service, where direct editor changes also arrive. For this introduction, ChatGPT, Claude Code and DeepSeek Harness made independent attempts. They can share the file and operation model while their editorial judgment is still assessed separately."
